{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blouse: relaxed fit with a soft V-neck and three-quarter sleeves, hip-skimming length, warm ivory (#E8DFD0), matte crepe.
Trousers: high-waisted, straight leg, full length to the ankle bone, deep charcoal (#3A3D42), fine wool blend with a slight drape.
Jacket: single-breasted, straight cut, hip length, one-button, soft shoulder, dark espresso brown (#4A3B32), textured wool bouclé tweed.
Loafers: classic almond toe, low block heel, dark chocolate (#2B1E18), smooth leather.
Belt: slim, with a small matte gold buckle, dark chocolate (#2B1E18), smooth leather.
Earrings: small round studs, muted antique gold (#B08D57), polished metal.
Bag: structured medium tote with a top handle, deep charcoal (#3A3D42), pebbled leather.

Why this outfit works: The palette is quiet and tonal, built from ivory, charcoal and espresso, so nothing is bright and the look stays restrained, as you wanted. The warm ivory blouse sits close to your face and complements your deep skin and dark hair, while the darker jacket and trousers give a clean, grounded line. The tweed texture adds autumn depth without fuss. Three-quarter sleeves are the one open zone, and with the straight trousers and loafers the whole look is neat, comfortable and right for a day at the office."}
